source_text: Nobis: mihi sponso et sponsae, vel mihi et sodalibus. Vel distinctio: capite nobis vulpes — pusillas exterminantes vineas, ut pusillas ad vineas referatur. Parvae animae laedi possunt; maiores non item.
pass_a_gloss: For-us: to-me bridegroom and to-bride, or to-me and to-companions. Or distinction: catch for-us foxes — little destroying vineyards, that little to vineyards may-be-referred. Small souls to-be-hurt are-able; greater not likewise.
pass_b_english: For us: for me the Bridegroom and for the Bride, or for me and my companions. Or with a pause: catch us the foxes — little ones that spoil vineyards — so that little refers to the vineyards. Small souls can be hurt; greater ones not likewise.
